items.claim: Santiago Ponzinibbio is unmotivated and lacks career direction.
items.quote: Santiago Ponzinibbio is talking about, &quot;Hey, I don't know really what's going to be next for my career.&quot; So, he's not all in.

items.claim: Santiago Ponzinibbio has solid takedown defense at 71%.
items.quote: Takedown defense is solid as well 71%.

items.claim: Santiago Ponzinibbio was recently knocked out late in the fight by Danny Rodriguez.
items.quote: He did just get knocked out by Danny Rodriguez pretty late.

items.claim: Dustin Jacoby was a top three ranked professional kickboxer.
items.quote: He was ranked in top three in the world, and had good amount of success.

items.claim: Dustin Jacoby has durability concerns and can be knocked out or dropped.
items.quote: He can be clipped. We've watched him completely flatline like in the Reyes fight.

items.claim: Valter Walker has won his last four fights by heel hook.
items.quote: All four of his last fights are wins. All four of those wins are by heel hook.

items.claim: Valter Walker's striking is not very good.
items.quote: Valter Walker, his striking is not very good.

items.claim: Valter Walker has a durable chin.
items.quote: He does have a chin on him. We saw that when Luis Sutherland absolutely blasted him.
